job_spec.purpose: S81 dsfd_bf (x512) compact199 pair col R0 | front | col MY: re-route of the CLOSED front ot_s81_bf_front (bfh_compact199_front_a1200_332bffbb6-cl, TT +91.55 / FF +17.74) with ONE change: an exact pin plan (physical/s81_bf_hier/front_pins_aligned.tcl) that puts the 776 column-interface pins of each face (c0_* W, c1_* E, M4) at the y of the closed column's E-face pins (bfh_compact199_col_kreg_a1200_05a8d46ee-cl) and c_qy_bkf_in[1:0] on the S face. Both seams become straight M4 abutment wires (were 0.192 / 0.096 um M5 jogs in a 1.188 um channel) and the columns' fault OR reaches the front in ~60 um under the frame (was 190 / 290 um around it). Same RTL, outline 100.224 x 198.72, recipe, SDC and clock as the closed route.
